title: DMK members protest at Thuraiyur against Deputy Speaker for ‘assaulting’ man

ai.summary: DMK members protested at Thuraiyur for allegedly assaulting a man, demanding Deputy Speaker M. Ravishankar's removal.

facts.claim: A group of members of the Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK) staged a demonstration at Thuraiyur in Tiruchi district on Wednesday condemning the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam MLA and Deputy Speaker of the Legislative Assembly M. Ravishankar after a recent video surfaced on social media showing him allegedly assaulting a local when the latter approached him to complain about drinking water shortage and other civic issues in his locality.
facts.quote: A group of members of the Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK) staged a demonstration at Thuraiyur in Tiruchi district on Wednesday condemning the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam MLA and Deputy Speaker of the Legislative Assembly M. Ravishankar after a recent video surfaced on social media showing him allegedly assaulting a local when the latter approached him to complain about drinking water shortage and other civic issues in his locality.

facts.claim: The demonstration organised by the DMK near the Thuraiyur bus stand lasted about 30 minutes.
facts.quote: The demonstration organised by the DMK near the Thuraiyur bus stand lasted about 30 minutes.

facts.claim: About 150 DMK members, led by the party’s north district secretary Kaduvetti Thiagarajan, participated in the demonstration.
facts.quote: About 150 DMK members, led by the party’s north district secretary Kaduvetti Thiagarajan, participated in the demonstration.

facts.claim: The protesters raised slogans demanding that Mr. Ravishankar should be removed from the post of Deputy Speaker, said the police sources.
facts.quote: The protesters raised slogans demanding that Mr. Ravishankar should be removed from the post of Deputy Speaker, said the police sources.
